cases.case: PRODUCER: real bounce-to-hand effect (from Battlefield, to Hand, validType creature)
cases.mirrors: Bigfin Bouncer (FDN) — real ETB bounce permanent
cases.note: Mocked Creature with an onEnter trigger whose effect is kind:'move', from:'Battlefield', to:'Hand', validType:'creature', target:true. Verified in etb.test.ts via matchSink.

cases.case: PRODUCER: graveyard-recursion move (from Graveyard, to Hand)
cases.mirrors: Vampire Soulcaller / Inspiration from Beyond (FDN) — real graveyard-recursion, NOT a bounce
cases.note: A card sitting in a graveyard is never a 'permanent' (CR 110.1), so returning it to hand is not the bounce/blink archetype this sink represents. Verified in etb.test.ts via matchSink.

cases.case: PRODUCER: move to a different destination (sacrifice-shaped, Battlefield -> Graveyard)
cases.mirrors: any real sacrifice effect with no bounce shape at all
cases.note: Mocked sacrifice effect. Proves real discrimination on the move's own `to`, not 'any zone-change effect counts'. Verified in etb.test.ts via matchSink.

cases.case: PRODUCER: vanilla creature, no effects at all
cases.mirrors: Serra Angel (FDN) — a real, deliberate no-bounce case
cases.note: Mocked vanilla creature. Verified in etb.test.ts via matchSink.

cases.case: CONSUMER: creature with a real on:'enter' trigger
cases.mirrors: Felidar Savior (FDN #12) / Helpful Hunter (FDN) — real ETB permanents worth re-triggering
cases.note: Mocked Creature with triggers:[{name:'onEnter', on:'enter', effects:[{kind:'drawCard'}]}] — matches via consumerTriggerOn regardless of the effect kind, and does NOT match the producer query (no move effect at all). Verified in etb.test.ts via matchesConsumerTriggerOn.

cases.case: CONSUMER: creature with a differently-scoped trigger (on:'attacks')
cases.mirrors: any real attack-triggered permanent with no ETB ability
cases.note: Mocked creature with triggers:[{name:'onAttack', on:'attacks', ...}] only. Verified in etb.test.ts via matchesConsumerTriggerOn.

cases.mirrors: Serra Angel (FDN) — a real, deliberate no-ETB case
cases.note: Mocked vanilla creature. Verified in etb.test.ts via matchesConsumerTriggerOn.

cases.case: CONSUMER: on:'enter' trigger on the BACK face of a transforming DFC
cases.mirrors: a transforming DFC whose back face carries the ETB ability
cases.note: Mocked front/back face pair; the onEnter trigger lives only on backFace.triggers. Verified in etb.test.ts via matchesConsumerTriggerOn.

cases.mirrors: Dazzling Angel (FDN #9) — real 'whenever another creature you control enters' shape, no `on` value at all
cases.expectedVerdict: matches (consumerTriggerNames only — consumerTriggerOn declines it, no `on` field set)
cases.note: Mocked Creature with triggers:[{name:'onOtherCreatureEnter', effects:[{kind:'gainLife'}]}]. Verified in etb.test.ts via matchesConsumerTriggerNames; matchesConsumerTriggerOn asserted false explicitly.

cases.mirrors: any real card whose name-only trigger reacts to something else entirely
cases.note: Mocked creature with a trigger named 'onLifeGain'. Verified in etb.test.ts via matchesConsumerTriggerNames.

cases.case: CONSUMER (consumerTriggerNames): 'onOtherCreatureEnter' on the BACK face of a transforming DFC
cases.mirrors: a transforming DFC whose back face carries the reactive trigger
cases.note: Mocked front/back face pair; the 'onOtherCreatureEnter' trigger lives only on backFace.triggers. Verified in etb.test.ts via matchesConsumerTriggerNames.
